comfy-scraper — Netlify daily data refresh

This site is a compute worker, not a web app. It has no pages worth serving — this stub exists so the production deploy has something to publish (scheduled functions only fire on published deploys).

Liveness is observable elsewhere:

  • build history: this site's Netlify deploys (one scrape-branch build per day, ~5 min)
  • data freshness: prod stats.json (built_at should be ≤ 1 day old)
  • runner state: state/last-run.json
  • backup layers: GitLab mirror (ansgareutychisO/comfy-templates) + Netlify Blobs store site:comfy-backup

See the comfy-scraper repo README + docs/ for the architecture. GHA weekly cron remains as backup.
